description: A custom ListView subclass (ExpandingListView) that supports expanding and collapsing list items with animated transitions, including handling of off-screen views during animations.

classes.name: ExpandingListView
classes.description: A custom ListView that supports expanding and collapsing items with animated transitions, handling off-screen views during animations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the list view and sets the item click listener.

methods.name: getTopAndBottomTranslations
methods.description: Calculates translation values for expanding or collapsing list items to animate bounds changes.

methods.name: expandView
methods.description: Expands a clicked list item with animation, adjusting surrounding items and handling off-screen views.

methods.name: collapseView
methods.description: Collapses a clicked list item with animation, adjusting surrounding items and handling off-screen views.

methods.name: getAnimation
methods.description: Creates an animation to change a view's top and bottom bounds by specified amounts.
